what_works: Large, colorful abstract shapes behind images create a focal point without clutter.
Generous use of whitespace enhances readability and creates a calm, uncluttered atmosphere.
Consistent use of rounded corners (16px radius) on image containers and the modal box adds visual cohesion.
Clear visual hierarchy distinguishes the main article from the sidebar content for easy scanning.
Centered modal dialog provides clear instructions while preserving the underlying layout structure.
